content: He who fears he will suffer, already suffers because of his fear.
author: Michel de Montaigne
story:
Retiring at age 38 to his circular tower library in Gascony amidst the horrific French Wars of Religion, Montaigne invented the 'essay' as a personal experiment in self-examination. In a time of murderous dogmatism, his radical motto 'Que sais-je?' (What do I know?) pioneered modern skepticism, empathy, and acceptance of human imperfection.

In formulating this reflection, Michel de Montaigne stripped away superficial conventions to address the core anatomy of fear. For Michel de Montaigne, true wisdom is never an abstract luxury, but an urgent practical discipline required to navigate life with clarity and unshakeable dignity.
reflectionPrompt: In what area of your life are you overthinking the ideal approach instead of taking the simple, honorable action?
